links.note: OVERWRITE of 31576 'Everyone knows Bepin Choudhury', which is the stranger's flattery. The item asks how the man watching him is described - round-faced and meek-looking - and that description is in 31573 'Watched at the bookshop'.

OVERWRITE of 31584 'Go back to Ranchi', which is Dr Chanda's advice much later. The item asks where he stayed for the Pujas (Haridas Bagchi's place, in Kanpur) - his alibi for October '58, which belongs to 31575 'Never been there'.

OVERWRITE of 31588 'The last joke', which is his later claim to Dr Chanda that memory returned. What he realised on getting off the train - that he had never been there - is 31586 'Nothing is familiar'.
